title: Salade d’avocats (Avocado Salad)
author: Joyce (AFS USA recipe submission)
desc: Tender avocados gently mixed with oil, vinegar, mustard, onion, tomato and garlic, with optional canned sardines and parsley — eaten for breakfast, often with baguettes.
longDesc: Submitted to AFS USA’s recipe collection by Joyce (source country Cameroon). The ingredients are mixed gently, taking care not to mash the avocado, which should stay in pieces. The page says the salad is eaten for breakfast and is often accompanied with baguettes. Time is printed as under 10 minutes.
steps: Mix all the ingredients together gently, taking care not to mash the avocado. You want to keep it in pieces.
chefTips: The printed cue is to keep the avocado in pieces.
commonMistakes: Over-salting: the page calls for a pinch.
healthBenefits: Avocado gives healthy fats and fibre.
culturalNote: The page lists Cameroon as the source country and says it is eaten for breakfast, often with baguettes. Byline: ‘AFS USA’ with ‘Submitted by: Joyce’.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Salade d’avocats’. Byline as printed: ‘AFS USA’; ‘Submitted by: Joyce’. Published 4 May 2020 (metadata). Time ‘< 10 min’. Yield not printed (servings 4 is a placeholder). TWO-PASS.
